name: net.clickwise/mcp
title: Clickwise Affiliate Network
description: Affiliate programs, deals, tracked links and product search, plus merchant program setup tools.

headers.name: X-API-Key
headers.description: Clickwise API key, optional. Program discovery, deals, catalog stats and tracked links work without it. Product search and GTIN lookup work with a free 14-day sandbox key that needs no account, from the Developers page (websiteUrl). Feeds, your links and reports need your publisher key.

headers.name: Authorization
headers.description: Merchant Bearer token, optional. Only the merchant tools that say "Merchant Bearer token required" use it: tracking test link, conversions key, integration status and results. The account gets it once, from get_merchant_credentials.
